shared_prompts.photo: Use case: photorealistic-natural. One real photograph for a Spanish-speaking adult beginner learning English. Natural everyday photographic detail, real material texture and correct perspective; NOT an illustration, 3D render, collage, cutout or app UI. Full-bleed 3:2 landscape; no frames, padding, blur bands, vignette, watermark or captions. A first-time learner must understand the picture instantly on a small phone screen. Every visible hand has five natural fingers. Do not imitate earlier course photos. No letters, words, numbers, logos or brand marks anywhere, not on signs, menus, screens, cups, clothes or bags.

shared_prompts.safe_center: Keep the people and the thing that carries the meaning inside the central 55 percent of the photo width, so a centered 4:5 crop keeps them whole; only expendable background reaches the left and right edges.
shared_prompts.solo: Only this one person is in the photo; there is nobody else, even far in the background.
shared_prompts.pair: Only these two people are in the photo; there is nobody else, even far in the background.
shared_prompts.daytime: It is clearly daytime with soft natural light.
shared_prompts.party: The place is the big bright community room of an apartment building on the evening of a neighbors' international dinner: long tables with white tablecloths, warm string lights, plants and big windows.
shared_prompts.noflag: There are no flags, banners or signs anywhere in the room.
shared_prompts.offframe: The person she is talking to is NOT in the photo: they stand just outside the edge of the photo that is named, so no part of that person (no hand, arm, shoulder or shadow) is visible.

assets.item: This is my sister. / Nice to meet you.
assets.prompt: Three real adults at the open front door of a house: a young woman with red hair, standing inside, introduces her younger sister (also red-haired, with freckles) to a smiling man with glasses who has just arrived; the man and the sister shake hands warmly. The woman rests a hand on her sister's shoulder. Only these three people are in the photo.

assets.item: She's cooking. He isn't cooking. He's eating.
assets.prompt: A real older couple in their kitchen: the woman, with short white hair and a striped apron, stirs a big pot on the stove; the man, bald with a grey mustache, sits at the kitchen table right behind her and eats soup from a bowl with a spoon. It is clear that she is cooking and he is eating.

Two real identical twin boys of twelve, with the same face, the same short black hair and the same green T-shirts, sit side by side at a table in a bright living room and smile at the camera. In front of each boy is his own small round chocolate birthday cake on a white plate, and on each cake stand two large, thick number candles that read 1 and 2 together as the number 12, each candle as tall as the boy's hand, with a small flame. The candle numbers face the camera and are sharp and easy to read even on a small phone screen. There is no number anywhere except the two cakes' candles.

assets.item: He's a cook. He works in a restaurant.
assets.prompt: A real man of about thirty-five with a black mustache, in a white chef's jacket and a white chef's hat, stands at the steel counter of a busy-looking but empty restaurant kitchen and puts fresh food on a plate, smiling. He is obviously a cook at work in a restaurant kitchen.

assets.item: Her hair is shorter than his. / His hair is long.
assets.prompt: A real young couple stand side by side in a sunny park and smile at the camera: the woman has very SHORT dark hair, cut close like a boy's; the man has very LONG straight brown hair down past his shoulders. Both are seen from the waist up, so both hairstyles are completely visible and the difference is obvious.

assets.item: Whose camera is this? It's his. / The headphones are hers.
assets.prompt: A real young man and woman sit side by side on a park bench and smile at the camera. The man holds a big black camera in both hands in front of him; the woman wears big white headphones on her head. Nothing else is in their hands.

A real older man with a white beard and a flat cap stands in front of his small white house on a quiet street and waters the flowers by his blue front door with a green watering can, smiling at the camera. On the wall right beside the door is one large black house number made of two metal digits: 11. The number is upright, sharp and easy to read even on a small phone screen. No other sign or digit is anywhere in the photo.

assets.item: She wants to be a farmer.
assets.prompt: A real girl of about eight in rubber boots and a straw hat kneels in a vegetable garden and proudly holds up a big carrot she has just pulled out, a small toy tractor beside her on the ground. She is obviously a child who wants to be a farmer.

assets.item: Stand up, please. / Sit down, please.
assets.prompt: A real classroom of teenagers: a smiling male teacher of about fifty with grey hair and glasses stands at the front and lifts both hands, palms up, asking the class to stand up. All six teenage students are STANDING beside their desks at the same moment. A large whiteboard behind him is completely blank. Only these people are in the room.

assets.item: She's three years older than him.
assets.prompt: A real teenage sister and her younger brother sit side by side at a table in a bright kitchen and smile at the camera; the sister is clearly older and taller. In front of each is their own small round white birthday cake on a white plate: on the sister's cake stand two large, thick number candles that read 1 and 7 together as 17; on the brother's cake, two large number candles that read 1 and 4 together as 14. Each candle is as tall as a hand, with a small flame, and the numbers face the camera, sharp and easy to read even on a small phone screen. There is no number anywhere except the candles.
